title: 第21章 女帝降临第22章 夷灭整个海德道域
slug: 反派神子开局送主角九族消消乐
content_zh:
场中，所有人尽皆俯首跪地。
瑟瑟发抖，低头不敢直视。
殿宇上空，猩红色的杀气如同实质般涌动翻滚。
宛若血浪翻腾。
犹如末日临世一般，压得众人几乎喘不过气来，连神魂都在微微颤栗。
一些修为稍弱之辈早已冷汗涔涔，衣袍湿透，面如土色，不敢发出半点声响。
生怕一个呼吸错乱，便被这股凌厉的杀意直接碾成血泥。
大殿寂静得可怕。
唯有林宏炎那断断续续的痛苦呻吟声，仿佛一道讽刺的丧钟，在众人心头敲响。
这时，姜夜点点头开口道：
“娘你先开个结界。”
苏红夜唇角微扬，眼中满是柔意与宠溺，与周围的肃杀气息格格不入，缓缓伸手揉了揉姜夜的脑袋。
“好。”
她轻声应道，唇角噙着笑意，随即手指轻弹，一道红光自掌心升起。
霎时间，红雾翻涌，宛如流云迅速弥散。
顷刻间便将母子二人笼罩其中，凝成一个泛着猩红微光的隐形结界，将外界一切目光、声音与气息尽数隔绝。
结界之外。
众人皆是屏息凝神，连动一下都不敢。
“说吧夜儿，要先拿哪个老家伙开刀？”
苏红夜神情淡然，仿若闲聊家常。

姜夜脸上神情顿时变得极为委屈，金眸微眯，咬牙切齿地说道：
“天道院！
那群老狗骨头硬得很！
大婚之日来我姜族闹事挑衅，刚才那古心德还要我给他天道院一个交代，要跟我们开启不朽战！
简直是嚣张至极！”
他顿了顿。
接着，又向苏红夜简单讲述了一番今日之事。
苏红夜听完后，原本温柔的神情顿时冷冽下来。
“天道院早已不复当年辉煌，人才凋零，天机大帝也生死未卜，如今还敢欺负我儿，那他们就没有存在的必要了！”
姜夜这才露出一丝笑容，眸中闪烁着狡黠的光芒，轻声说道：
“嗯！
娘你信吗？据传闻古心德这只老狗有某种秘法，配合他后天觉醒的天机眼，能够在一定程度上，看到他人身上的气运所在！”
“天道院当中，肯定还有不少老古董有类似的推演之法…”
content_en:
In the field, everyone bowed their heads and knelt down.
Shivering, lowering his head and not daring to look directly.
In the sky above the palace, scarlet murderous aura surged and rolled like substance.
It's like a surging wave of blood.
It was like the end of the world was coming, so overwhelming that everyone could hardly breathe, and even their souls were trembling slightly.
Some of the weaker ones were already covered in cold sweat, their robes were soaked, their faces were earth-colored, and they did not dare to make any sound.
He was afraid that if he lost his breath, he would be crushed into bloody mud by this fierce killing intent.
The hall was eerily silent.
Only Lin Hongyan's intermittent painful moans sounded like an ironic death knell in everyone's hearts.
At this time, Jiang Ye nodded and said:
"Mom, open a barrier first."
The corners of Su Hongye's lips were slightly raised, and her eyes were full of tenderness and affection, which was incompatible with the chilling atmosphere around her. She slowly reached out and rubbed Jiang Ye's head.
"Okay."
She responded softly, with a smile on her lips, then flicked her fingers, and a red light rose from her palm.
In an instant, the red mist surged and dispersed quickly like flowing clouds.
In an instant, the mother and son were enveloped, forming an invisible barrier glowing with scarlet light, cutting off all sight, sound and breath from the outside world.
Outside the barrier.
Everyone was holding their breath and concentrating, not even daring to move.
"Tell me, Ye'er, which old guy should be operated on first?"
Su Hongye's expression was indifferent, as if she was chatting at home.
The expression on Jiang Ye's face suddenly became extremely aggrieved, his golden eyes narrowed slightly, and he gritted his teeth and said:
“Tiandaoyuan!
Those old dogs are very hard-boned!
On our wedding day, the Jiang clan came to cause trouble and provoke trouble. Just now, Gu Xinde asked me to give him an explanation from the Tiandao Academy and start an immortal war with us!
It's simply arrogant! "
He paused.
Then, he briefly told Su Hongye what happened today.
After Su Hongye heard this, her originally gentle expression suddenly turned cold.
"Tiandao Academy has long lost its former glory, its talents have withered, and Emperor Tianji's life or death is uncertain. If they still dare to bully my son now, then there is no need for them to exist!"
Jiang Ye then showed a smile, with a cunning light in his eyes, and said softly:
"Hmm!
Mother, do you believe it? According to rumors, Gu Xinde, an old dog, has some kind of secret power. Combined with his acquired clairvoyance, he can see the luck of others to a certain extent! "
"There must be many old antiques in Tiandaoyuan who have similar deduction methods..."
